text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having a conversation with regional-born 
Oguri Cap. Regional roots and poverty... 
While both started underprivileged, their 
ways of life were complete opposites.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap grew strong through being loved 
and "fulfilled" by those around her. 
Tamamo Cross, on the other hand, had grown 
strong from "hunger."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Oguri Cap was the alter ego of the 
sun. The other self that could have been. 
That is precisely why she stirs up such 
strong rivalry within her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Oguri Cap also considers Tamamo 
Cross her one and only rival, and makes it 
clear she will forgo the Classic Triple 
Crown to head for the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
